audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Karma Levels 1 and 2 at 3.5/10, called Level 3 and Level 6 'Skill' and gave her 2+ items at 3/10 — while whys[0] through whys[4] and whys[6] all describe Garen winning those stages.
audit.why: 54.59% over 6127 games and the packet chart reads Garen for six of seven stages, Skill only at first item. Every disputed token contradicted both the packet and the page's own prose; only first item, where whys[5] genuinely says 'it comes down to whether she times her Mantra shield', is a real skill stage.
audit.corrected: Chart set as one group to Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Skill/Garen with ratings raised, and the two summary lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] credited Garen with a 'Q knockup-slow'. Decisive Strike has no knockup. Nothing anywhere explained how Focused Resolve is actually beaten, and Gathering Fire was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text for Decisive Strike: move speed, slow-break, bonus damage, silence — no displacement of any kind. Focused Resolve is a tether that only roots if it is not broken, so walking out of its 675 range is the counterplay, not tanking it. And Gathering Fire means every damaging ability she lands cuts Mantra's 40/38/36/34s cooldown, so 'wait for Mantra' is not a fixed timer.
audit.corrected: The invented knockup removed; the tether-break stated explicitly; Mantra's cooldown and Gathering Fire's reduction written in.

audit.why: spikes[1] already gets the important structural point right — Mantra is available from level 1 and costs no skill point, so Karma has no level-6 spike while Garen gets Demacian Justice. I left that intact and only added Mantra's real cooldown elsewhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing anywhere, and the itemization block buys none.
audit.why: Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals Karma while extending the root, so anti-heal is what decides the extended trade Garen is trying to force.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds attached to the Mantra-W heal in dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: Enemy misses or wastes Karma tether root links and mantra inner flames; Garen immediately Q sprints forward, silences them, executes a full Judgment spin loop to shred their armor, and drops Demacian Justice for an easy kill.
edits.after: She whiffs Inner Flame or spends Mantra on a shield: Decisive Strike (Q) closes on the move-speed burst and silences Focused Resolve, Judgment (E) melts her low HP, and Demacian Justice executes on missing health.

edits.before: Karma has no reliable escape once your Q knockup-slow and E are up; she only survives with perfect Mantra-shield timing, hence the skill window.
edits.after: Karma has no escape once Decisive Strike's move speed and slow are up; she survives on Mantra-shield timing, and Gathering Fire cuts that 40s cooldown.

notes: The 'Q knockup-slow' in spikes[3] was an invented mechanic — Garen has no displacement in his kit at all — and it sat on the owner's own champion, which is the kind of error a player would catch and lose trust over. Note also that the full layer refers to Karma as 'his'/'he' throughout (focus, do's, don'ts, report[9]-[12]); I corrected the pronoun only in fields I was already rewriting, since a pronoun-only edit is under the 25-character threshold and would not apply.
